rules.dialogue: every v5 take at its stick-timeline placement, unity on both channels; room early reflections as a send
rules.music: six to-picture cues at 0 dB from stems; each composer's duck map on its own files; slew-limited (falls <= 60 dB/s, begun early; rises <= 20 dB/s); top-up to D/M >= 12 dB (10 for the V.O.), at most 4 dB
rules.effects: the SFX sheet, its own conventions; its optional cues off except FX048; the mixer's small-speaker chains for device cues
rules.beds: the sheet's 19 beds at their RMS targets, faded and ridden as the sheet says; the bus +1.5 dB (the master gain's compensation) and +2 dB inside three designed music-off windows
rules.d6: act f 997-1086: every bus digital zero except the Cancel click's first 0.25 s
rules.master: one gain to -16.5 LUFS integrated, a linked 4x-oversampled look-ahead limiter at -1.3 dBTP; the same gain on every stem, so the stems sum to the mix

dialogue.text: Three of us stepped down this year.
Leave out Mas and Gerg, and the four of us are a majority.
This board controls the company. Not the other way round.
Our biggest investor has put in billions. It gets this many votes.
And the CEO? What does he own?
Mas. The board has decided that you will no longer lead the company. It will be announced shortly.
Step two. I'll read it once before it goes up.
…he was not consistently candid in his communications with the board… The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading NopeAI.
Step three. Rima, thank you for agreeing to serve as interim CEO while we search.
The staff will ask you what happened.
What the post says. That's all the board is saying for now.
Is this a coup? Because it looks like one.
You can call it this way… I disagree with this. This was the board doing its duty to the mission of the nonprofit…
Nobody asked him to go. He'd have kept his job, just not the chair.
Gerg has never waited to be asked.
They're all asking whether it was allowed. It was. The charter, footnote three. I've read it four times tonight.
What they actually want to know is what happens on Monday. I'd like to be able to tell them something.
That isn't a time, Alyi. All we've given the staff since yesterday is more soon.
That is the company telling us.
Then we'll write step four ourselves.
Mario, it's Neleh, from the NopeAI board. I'll be direct. The board is offering you the job of CEO, and it wants to discuss a merger.
Neleh, hi. Wow. I've actually written up some thoughts on exactly this. Eleven pages, on the conditions under which we might, hypothetically—
Hi. Yes. We're very worried. How much?
He's been in the building for hours. We've talked all day about him coming back, and we're no closer.
They gave him a guest badge.
It's the correct badge. He doesn't work here.
Ttemme, we'd like you to serve as interim CEO.
You already have an interim CEO.
Fine. But before I say yes, I need to know why you fired him.
Good evening. You'll want to hear our statement.

We look forward to getting to know Ttemme and NopeAI's new leadership team and working with them. And we're extremely excited to share the news that Mas Manalt and Gerg Mockbran, together with colleagues, will be joining Macrosoft to lead a new advanced AI research team.
Sorry, one sec. I've got a build compiling.
it's two in the morning, gerg.
Best time there is. Nobody else is pushing anything. Anyway, that's not why I called. You've got the staff letter open? Scroll down.
They're telling the board they're "…unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgment and care for our mission and employees."
And they'll quit, "…unless all current board members resign…"
Yep. Macrosoft's promised them "…positions for all NopeAI employees…"
That'll be the share sale. Everybody's been waiting on that one.
The company. Again. Just in case.
So. Do I tell everyone to pack?
Don't get up, Mas. I won't keep you. Everyone is welcome.
Yes. You first. And there's a desk for every one of them.
what happens to you if nopeai disappears?
Oh, we'd be fine. …we have all the IP rights and all the capability… We are below them, above them, around them.

Before this goes out, I'm reading it once, so nobody's surprised. We have reached an agreement in principle for Mas Manalt to return to NopeAI as CEO with a new initial board of Terb (Chair), the Other Yrral, and Mada.
He stays. You and Gerg don't sit on the board.
And there'll be an independent review.
You said that about the last one.
i love and respect alyi, i think he's a guiding light of the field and a gem of a human being. i harbor zero ill will towards him.
